name: jobs_calibration

targets.source: FILL: Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker, job switchers, 2025, p25/p50/p75 of 12-month wage growth

_notes: Targets are log(1 + g/100), where g is the tracker's percent wage growth for job switchers at the 25th, 50th and 75th percentiles. The tracker's data download (Excel) has the percentile series; take the 2025 average, or the months that match the development months.
The tracker is national; NYC is not separately available. Record this as a known mismatch.
64 per side, natural sampling (no stratification), calibration donors only, seeds 1000-1019, disjoint from the pilot's 0-19.
9 settings x 4 cells x 7 months x 20 seeds = 5,040 market builds with DA only; expect tens of minutes.
